name: Jura
source: Yuri Lyubovich never intended to become part of history. A quiet, artistic soul, he initially tries to avoid the brewing political storm around him, finding solace in painting and the companionship of his sister, Yesenia. However, fate has other plans. Through a series of seemingly small decisions—attending a political discussion, signing a petition, befriending the wrong (or right) people—he is slowly drawn into the chaos that will shape the future of Ardena.
